C1418.title: DeFi Protocols Lost $403 Million to Oracle Manipulation Attacks in 2022
C1418.summary: According to Chainalysis estimates, DeFi protocols lost $403.2 million across 41 separate oracle manipulation attacks in 2022. These attacks exploited manipulated external data feeds, causing smart contracts to reference incorrect prices, leading to significant losses for lending protocols and decentralized exchanges.

references.title: Oracle Manipulation Attacks Rising: A Unique Concern for DeFi
